recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future follow-up, if any, should be handled through later DiagnosticReport.supportingInfo terminology/modeling issues or Extension Pack maintenance rather than reopening FHIR-15521.
issue_request: FHIR-15521 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and requested DiagnosticReport support for references to other information considered in creating or interpreting a diagnostic report. The final resolution was to create standard extension event-supportingInfo with cardinality 0..*, type Reference(Any), and DiagnosticReport context.
initial_application: No modern FHIR-15521-tagged commit was found, but historical commit 2ebd7c6f references GF#15521 and added supportingInfo to source/profiles/event-extensions-spreadsheet.xml with DiagnosticReport and Observation contexts, 0..*, Reference(Any), and patient-record supporting-information wording. Commit 36d02fb3 also documented the event-supportingInfo extension in ballot notes.
additional_context: The linked Zulip GF#15521 thread records OO's 4-0-1 motion to make this a standard extension and clarifies the intended patient-record supporting-info semantics distinct from RelatedArtifact. Later FHIR-36858 made DiagnosticReport.supportingInfo a core R5 backbone element with type and reference children. Later FHIR-53024 clarified that Extension Pack workflow-supportingInfo should list DiagnosticReport only for R4B and earlier, which the Extension Pack source now does with endFhirVersion 4.3.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active core DiagnosticReport source already contains DiagnosticReport.supportingInfo and an example, so reintroducing or editing a core extension in this checkout would be stale relative to the later R5/R6 model.
